22class N6705PowerAnalyzer:
23 def __init__(self, client: ScpiTcpClient) -> None:
24 self._client = client
25 self._supports_batch_measure = True
26 # MEAS:POW? is unsupported on many N6705 modules; computing P = V * I is safer and faster.
27 self._supports_power_measure = False
28
29 def connect(self) -> None:
30 self._client.connect()
31
32 def disconnect(self) -> None:
33 self._client.disconnect()
34
35 @property
36 def is_connected(self) -> bool:
37 return self._client.is_connected
38
39 def identify(self) -> str:
40 return self._client.query("*IDN?")
41
42 def get_channel_count(self) -> int:
43 response = self._client.query("SYST:CHAN?")
44 count = int(_parse_single_float(response))
45 return max(1, min(4, count))
46
47 def get_error(self) -> str:
48 return self._client.query("SYST:ERR?")
49
50 def set_voltage(self, channel: int, voltage_v: float) -> None:
51 self._client.write(f"VOLT {voltage_v:.6g},(@{channel})")
52
53 def set_current(self, channel: int, current_a: float) -> None:
54 self._client.write(f"CURR {current_a:.6g},(@{channel})")
55
56 def get_voltage_setpoint(self, channel: int) -> float:
57 response = self._client.query(f"VOLT? (@{channel})")
58 return _parse_single_float(response)
59
60 def get_current_setpoint(self, channel: int) -> float:
61 response = self._client.query(f"CURR? (@{channel})")
62 return _parse_single_float(response)
63
64 def get_voltage_min_limit(self, channel: int) -> float:
65 # Per programming guide: VOLT? [MIN|MAX,] (@chanlist)
66 response = self._client.query(f"VOLT? MIN,(@{channel})")
67 return _parse_single_float(response)
68
69 def get_voltage_max_limit(self, channel: int) -> float:
70 # Per programming guide: VOLT? [MIN|MAX,] (@chanlist)
71 response = self._client.query(f"VOLT? MAX,(@{channel})")
72 return _parse_single_float(response)
73
74 def get_current_min_limit(self, channel: int) -> float:
75 # Per programming guide: CURR? [MIN|MAX,] (@chanlist)
76 response = self._client.query(f"CURR? MIN,(@{channel})")
77 return _parse_single_float(response)
78
79 def get_current_max_limit(self, channel: int) -> float:
80 # Per programming guide: CURR? [MIN|MAX,] (@chanlist)
81 response = self._client.query(f"CURR? MAX,(@{channel})")
82 return _parse_single_float(response)
83
84 def set_output(self, channel: int, enabled: bool) -> None:
85 state = "ON" if enabled else "OFF"
86 self._client.write(f"OUTP {state},(@{channel})")
87
88 def get_output_state(self, channel: int) -> bool:
89 response = self._client.query(f"OUTP? (@{channel})")
90 return int(float(response)) == 1
91
92 def measure_channels(self, channels: Iterable[int]) -> list[ChannelMeasurement]:
93 ordered = sorted(set(channels))
94 if not ordered:
95 return []
96
97 if self._supports_batch_measure:
98 try:
99 chanlist = _format_chanlist(ordered)
100 voltages = _parse_float_list(self._client.query(f"MEAS:VOLT? {chanlist}"), len(ordered))
101 currents = _parse_float_list(self._client.query(f"MEAS:CURR? {chanlist}"), len(ordered))
102
103 if self._supports_power_measure:
104 try:
105 powers = _parse_float_list(self._client.query(f"MEAS:POW? {chanlist}"), len(ordered))
106 except Exception:
107 self._supports_power_measure = False
108 powers = [voltages[idx] * currents[idx] for idx in range(len(ordered))]
109 else:
110 powers = [voltages[idx] * currents[idx] for idx in range(len(ordered))]
111
112 now = datetime.now()
113 return [
114 ChannelMeasurement(
115 timestamp=now,
116 channel=channel,
117 voltage_v=voltages[idx],
118 current_a=currents[idx],
119 power_w=powers[idx],
120 )
121 for idx, channel in enumerate(ordered)
122 ]
123 except Exception:
124 # Avoid paying a timeout penalty on every poll if chanlist queries are unsupported.
125 self._supports_batch_measure = False
126
127 # Fallback: query channel-by-channel when a mixed chanlist fails.
128 samples: list[ChannelMeasurement] = []
129 last_exc: Exception | None = None
130 for channel in ordered:
131 try:
132 voltage_v = _parse_single_float(self._client.query(f"MEAS:VOLT? (@{channel})"))
133 current_a = _parse_single_float(self._client.query(f"MEAS:CURR? (@{channel})"))
134
135 if self._supports_power_measure:
136 try:
137 power_w = _parse_single_float(self._client.query(f"MEAS:POW? (@{channel})"))
138 except Exception:
139 self._supports_power_measure = False
140 power_w = voltage_v * current_a
141 else:
142 power_w = voltage_v * current_a
143
144 samples.append(
145 ChannelMeasurement(
146 timestamp=datetime.now(),
147 channel=channel,
148 voltage_v=voltage_v,
149 current_a=current_a,
150 power_w=power_w,
151 )
152 )
153 except Exception as exc: # noqa: BLE001
154 last_exc = exc
155
156 if not samples and last_exc is not None:
157 raise last_exc
158 return samples
159

161def _format_chanlist(channels: Iterable[int]) -> str:
162 numeric_channels = [int(ch) for ch in channels]
163 if not numeric_channels:
164 raise ValueError("La lista de canales no puede estar vacía")
165 return "(@" + ",".join(str(ch) for ch in numeric_channels) + ")"
166
167
168def _parse_float_list(response: str, expected_count: int) -> list[float]:
169 tokens = [token.strip() for token in response.split(",") if token.strip()]
170 if len(tokens) != expected_count:
171 raise ValueError(
172 f"Cantidad de datos inesperada. Esperado={expected_count}, recibido={len(tokens)}. "
173 f"Respuesta='{response}'"
174 )
175 return [float(token) for token in tokens]
176
177
178def _parse_single_float(response: str) -> float:
179 token = response.strip().split(",")[0]
180 return float(token)
